verdict.rationale: Runloop documents devbox tunnels for reaching ports on a devbox over a URL. A tutorial uses those tunnels to start an app and share a live preview link in pull requests, which covers exposing in-sandbox services at a shareable preview URL. Missing for 10: detailed docs on public vs. authenticated access and URL/port configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a port from the sandbox on a public preview URL to reach services running inside

citations.quote: Let’s use devbox tunnels to securely access ports on your devbox over a simple url.
